Decide which contrasts can be tested with pseudobulk edgeR

check_pseudobulk_design.Rd

Applies scDE's replication rules to the sample x group profiles of an object, without reading any expression data. For every requested contrast it reports whether edgeR can run (method = "edgeR") or whether run_dge() / run_dge_multicontrast() will fall back to the cell-level Wilcoxon test (method = "wilcoxon"), and why. The same function drives the tests themselves, so a preflight in an application and the eventual run always agree.

Usage

check_pseudobulk_design(
  design,
  contrasts,
  min_cells = 10L,
  min_replicates = 2L
)

Arguments

design

A scuba_pseudobulk_design from SCUBA::pseudobulk_design(), a scuba_pseudobulk from SCUBA::pseudobulk(), or a data.frame with columns sample, group and n_cells.

contrasts

A data.frame with character columns group_1 and group_2 (one row per contrast; group_2 may be "rest").

min_cells

Minimum cells for a sample x group profile to count.

min_replicates

Minimum samples per side (independent design) or paired samples (paired design) for edgeR; the default of 2 is the hard minimum, three or more are recommended and fewer produce a warning when the test runs.

Value

A list with

  • contrasts: data.frame with one row per contrast: group_1, group_2, contrast, method ("edgeR" or "wilcoxon"), design_type ("independent" or "paired"), samples_group_1, samples_group_2 (samples retained per side), paired_samples, and reason (why the contrast falls back, NA otherwise);

  • any_edger, any_fallback;

  • warnings: notes about contrasts that run with fewer than three replicates or with excluded profiles;

  • selections: the per-contrast profile tables (internal detail used by the tests).

Details

A profile (one sample in one group) counts when it has at least min_cells cells. The design of a contrast is paired when at least one sample has both groups (cluster versus cluster, treated versus untreated cells of the same donor); edgeR then needs min_replicates such samples and fits ~ sample + group. Otherwise the design is independent and edgeR needs min_replicates samples on each side (~ 0 + group). group_2 = "rest" pools, per sample, every group other than group_1.

See also

run_dge(), run_dge_multicontrast(), SCUBA::pseudobulk_design()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
design <- SCUBA::pseudobulk_design(SCUBA::AML_Seurat, "Batch", "condensed_cell_type")
check_pseudobulk_design(
  design,
  contrasts = data.frame(group_1 = "B Cells", group_2 = c("NK Cells", "rest"))
)$contrasts
} # }
